coverage: Whole image inspected once for layout, then half a and half b once each against both textual witnesses. All heading letters; all 19 table rows, labels, counts, question marks, underlines, cancelled rows and overtyped references; three right marginal notes; all four pointer strokes, grouping brace/brackets, and SGA 7 frames; both prose paragraphs including clipped right-edge text; bottom archive number were read. Fifteen unique tight crops of unresolved loci were each viewed once. No source region remains unviewed. No OCR, external source, other page, or other reader was inspected.

changes.evidence: Half a, top heading: a distinct p with descender stands between i and t. The heading capitals S, G, A and M were each checked; no distinct double-struck alphabet was established.

changes.kind: deletion state (struck given live or live given struck)
changes.evidence: Crop 02 shows both the bowed top/diagonal/base of 2 and a crossing, descending stem of 4 in one type position. Their superposition is visible; which digit was typed last is not determined.
changes.mathematical_consequence: The SGA identifier remains 4/2 in the ink; no contextual restoration is made.

changes.locus: SGA 4, Exp IV (fin), underlined page count
changes.evidence: Crop 03: a long top horizontal, left upright and lower bowl identify 5. The digit is heavily struck, but no independent earlier digit is securely separable. The underscore belongs to 50, above the following 80.

changes.locus: SGA 4, Exp VI B, first Saint Donat
changes.kind: deletion state (struck given live or live given struck)
changes.evidence: Crop 04: the second letter has the two-storey a and a separate q descender ending below the baseline in a serif. This is a distinct q/a overtype, not simply a thicker a.

changes.kind: deletion state (struck given live or live given struck)
changes.evidence: Crop 05: the flat foot and upright of 1 coexist with the broad upper bar and lower bowl of 5. Both are visible; strike order is uncertain.
changes.mathematical_consequence: 10 versus 50 changes this estimated page count; no total was recomputed.

changes.evidence: Crop 06: the initial X contains a thick central upright that may belong to an underlying I; the image does not exclude mere overstriking of X. The C alternatives are retained. This row records uncertainty, not a categorical rejection of H XVII.

changes.kind: deletion state (struck given live or live given struck)
changes.evidence: Crop 07: two separate I stems with top serifs remain under two lower-case x cancellation strikes. A clean I and V follow them. There are two cancelled positions, not three, and the initial X of H is a cancellation mark.
Half a, first SGA 7 row: the middle digit has a diagonal to a flat lower foot, a clear 2. The final question mark is in the source.

changes.kind: deletion state (struck given live or live given struck)
changes.evidence: Crop 08: one cancelled type position has the two upper arms and pointed junction of V; a separate live V follows. The cancelled letter is vertically overtyped several times, but no second adjacent cancelled I is present.

changes.locus: Top right margin beside the cancelled SGA 1 row
changes.evidence: Crop 01: before the surname there is a tall left stroke, a low connecting curve, and a final tall loop. These allow tel or Cl; the ink supports alternatives rather than an empty illegibility marker. The surname remains uncertain. H marks this locus as illegible/uncertain.

changes.locus: NB paragraph, end of fourth typed line
changes.evidence: Crop 10: envisagé is clear; the remaining left portions of the final letter at the page edge form the upper and lower curves of s. The right side of that s is clipped, but its surviving form decides the word.

changes.locus: NB paragraph, extra letter after mise
changes.kind: deletion state (struck given live or live given struck)
changes.evidence: Crop 11: the x overstrike covers a lower-case r with a left upright, right shoulder and lower serif. The cancelled r is retained explicitly.

changes.locus: NB paragraph, word inside opening parenthesis
changes.evidence: Crop 12: between co and ection there are compressed superposed r-like stems and serifs; they do not securely distinguish two r letters from an overstruck single r. The C alternatives remain. This row records uncertainty, not a certain H error.

changes.locus: NB paragraph, word after la rénumération de la
changes.evidence: Crop 13 shows a separate acute accent over the first e and another acute over the e after r. Both acute marks rise to the right.

changes.kind: deletion state (struck given live or live given struck)
changes.evidence: Crop 14: each of the two positions after v contains both an e contour and an i stem/dot. The unovertyped tail nnent is clear. A transposition ei/ie has been overtyped, but the relative strike order is not recoverable; both orderings are retained.

changes.locus: Last paragraph, count after les env.
changes.kind: deletion state (struck given live or live given struck)
changes.evidence: Crop 15: the first digit contains the two rounded lobes of 3 together with the descending diagonal and flat foot of 2. Both visible forms are recorded; which replaced which is uncertain.
changes.mathematical_consequence: 200 versus 300 is a source count uncertainty; the later 450–500 wording was not used to decide it.

changes.kind: deletion state (struck given live or live given struck)
changes.evidence: Half a: the long pencil cancellation begins across the SGA 1 label and continues through the row. H leaves the item label outside its struck macro, although its editorial note correctly says the whole line is crossed out.

notes.text: The sheet is an undated, unsigned typed preparation list headed SGA : Manuscripts à frapper. There is no authorial page number; the isolated pencil 2 at bottom left is treated as the archive number. Attribution of the handwriting is not established by this page.
notes.basis: Observation: heading, complete margins and footer.

notes.text: Nineteen table rows list exposés and introductory/index matter, named contributors and estimated page counts. The SGA 1 row and the entire two-row SGA 6 block are cancelled. Source question marks occur in author and count positions, notably SGA 5 Exp IV, SGA 6 Ferrand and SGA 7 first row; these question marks are not editorial doubts.
notes.basis: Observation: full table. No arithmetic check or external bibliographical identification was performed.

notes.text: The NB explains that underlined counts refer to manuscripts immediately available and a following ? to manuscripts whose eventual preparation is uncertain. It discusses additional revision work and a possible forfait for each seminar. The spellings rénumération and sécrétaire, and the deleted r after mise, are preserved.
notes.basis: Observation: NB paragraph; crop 11 for r, crop 13 for both accents in sécrétaire.

notes.text: The final paragraph states about 250 pages ready, hopes for an overtyped 200/300 further SGA 4 pages in two or three months, and gives 450 à 500 pages for the next five or six months. It says this depends on Mr. Verdier, at Brandeis cette année, and states Je me mets en rapport avec lui ces jours-ci. These are prospective source claims; no date was inferred and no numerical consistency was used to restore the overtyped count.
notes.basis: Observation: last paragraph and crop 15. No computation or proof checking.

notes.text: Pencil notes include a doubtful tel/Cl Saarbach, underlined écrire Bucur, and underlined écr. Deligne. The small SGA 4 brace includes the 80 row; the large mark is a square bracket. The four pointer strokes attach to SGA 4 Exp IV (fin), SGA 5 Exp VII, SGA 5 Exp XI and SGA 7 Exp VI.
notes.basis: Observation: half a; crop 01 for doubtful handwriting; crop 09 for framed counts. The schema hand value another unnamed hand denotes unattributed handwriting, not an established second author.

notes.text: No mathematical assertion on this administrative page was proof-checked. check_events is intentionally empty. Counts were transcribed, not summed or normalized.
notes.basis: Epistemic status of this reader run.

notes.text: The double characters in the SGA label, VI B count, first viennent and final paragraph count visibly support superposed types, but their chronology is not legible. The alternatives in reading.tex retain both possible strike orders. They are observations of composite ink with a cautious state interpretation, not corrected wording inferred from context.

brief_feedback: No substantive ambiguity affected the reading. The exact initial start time was not logged; started_utc candidly gives the first recorded timestamp, taken after initial source views. All image and crop views were performed once. Differences explicitly described in H editorial notes are marked_in_H true even where H main text markup differs. Unresolved alternatives against a certain H reading are explicitly identified as uncertainty, not categorical H errors.
